path_order: path_idx 0..414089 in canonical Gamma municipality/access order
representation: CSR-like ordered sequence. For path_idx p, transition slots are transition_slots[offsets[p]:offsets[p+1]].

transition_slot_semantics.slot_reference: zero-based CSR data position in frozen B5 arrays
transition_slot_semantics.cumulative_time: prefix sum of B5 time_s over ordered path slots
transition_slot_semantics.cumulative_length: prefix sum of B5 length_m over ordered path slots
